`dtc-device-login.mjs` is the unmodified shared Node device-login implementation
from `DataTalksClub/auth`, commit `e741073cf1004a2318d3bcf9a62c69541f4c552a`,
path `dtc_device_login/login.mjs`. The source repository is Python-packaged and
does not publish an npm package. Preserve this file verbatim when updating;
the browser CLI supplies only transport, role and credential storage.
